guitar.notes: Brad Delson is well documented using PRS Custom 24 guitars throughout Linkin Park's career; keeping medium confidence as it's well-known but not as singularly iconic as e.g. Slash's Les Paul.

tone.target: tight nu-metal crunch with muted riff punch
tone.profile: tight nu-metal crunch with muted riff punch
tone.summary: A compressed signal chain utilizing a Boost for attack, Distortion for mid-tight crunch, and the UK 800 amp with a 4x12 cabinet to achieve aggressive, punchy nu-metal riffs.

rig.name: Linkin Park - In The End - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and hum inherent in modern metal tones.
Increase signal level and add initial compression to enhance the 'punch' of palm-muted riffs.
blocks.gap: Using Boost for compression/attack enhancement, as a dedicated compressor is not available in the PRE section.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core mid-tight distortion and aggressive riff bite required for nu-metal crunch.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is chosen over RAT/Muff to maintain a more controlled, modern high-gain sound rather than an overly saturated or fuzzy one.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the modern high-gain Marshall sound (Marshall/modern high-gain clue) necessary for aggressive rock tones.
Provide the required 4x12 cabinet tone and solid foundation for the aggressive sound.
Sculpt the tone by boosting mids for aggressive riff bite and tightening up the low end, crucial for palm-muting.
Included as a potential alternative for subtle movement if the tone needs widening, but kept inactive per 'avoid' list.
blocks.gap: The Chorus is explicitly avoided in the musical verdict. It is included here only to fulfill the minimum block requirement while acknowledging its low priority.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space to the overall sound without distracting from the tight riffing.
Provide a natural sense of space and glue the aggressive tones together.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and overall punch by swapping the default IR for a more aggressive, modern 4x12 simulation.

proposals.reason: Enhance the aggressive, tight punch required for nu-metal.
